_comment: Every place a user reads Pollis text, and whether it follows their language (#1724). Read by `node scripts/i18n-check.mjs --report` (scripts/i18n-report.mjs) and by the i18n-surfaces dimension of scripts/sweep.mjs; scripts/surfaces.json (#1728) points here.
decision: `localize` (it should follow the user's language) or `english-only` (it deliberately does not; `reason` says why).

status (localize only): `localized` (every shipped locale, from the shared catalogues), `partial` (some of it; `debt` says what is left), or `debt` (not yet; `debt` says what it needs). A surface that needs a wire or Delivery Service change is debt, never built client-side around the DS.
paths: the code or content that produces the text; each must exist. checked_by: the test or check that keeps a localized surface localized.

Adding a surface: add an entry here when you add a new place copy can come from (a native string table, a server-written message, a new public page type), then run `node scripts/i18n-check.mjs --report`.

desktop-renderer.title: Desktop app UI (React renderer)
desktop-renderer.reason: The app's own screens, menus, toasts and errors, in every shipped locale from frontend/src/i18n/locales.
desktop-renderer.checked_by: scripts/i18n-check.mjs (catalogue integrity, call sites, hardcoded-copy ratchet), e2e/i18n.spec.ts, e2e/rtl.spec.ts, e2e/locale-smoke.spec.ts

mobile-app.title: Mobile app UI (Expo)
mobile-app.reason: Same catalogues as desktop (mobile namespace for mobile-only copy).
mobile-app.checked_by: scripts/i18n-check.mjs (incl. the glossary), mobile/tests/i18n.test.ts, mobile/.maestro/flows/i18n.yaml, mobile/.maestro/flows/locale-smoke.yaml

ios-permission-strings.title: iOS permission prompts (NS*UsageDescription)
ios-permission-strings.reason: Camera, photo library (read and add) and Face ID prompts, from mobile:permissions.*, written as <lproj>/InfoPlist.strings at prebuild. iOS picks the language from the device (or iOS Settings → Pollis → Language), not the in-app picker, which iOS cannot see.

android-permission-rationale.title: Android permission dialogs and rationale
android-permission-rationale.reason: Android's runtime permission dialog is written and localized by the OS; the app declares no rationale strings of its own. The in-app copy around a permission (allow camera, saving to photos denied) is in the catalogues.

push-android.title: Android notifications (rich push handler, channel name)
push-android.reason: values-<lng>/pollis_push_strings.xml generated from mobile:push.*; Android picks the device language.

push-ios.title: iOS notifications (Notification Service Extension)
push-ios.reason: <lproj>/Localizable.strings generated from mobile:push.* at prebuild; the extension follows the iOS language.

push-ds-fallback.title: The Delivery Service's own push text ("New message")
push-ds-fallback.reason: Shown when the device cannot fetch the message itself (a token without the rich capability, the iOS extension timing out, before the first unlock on a new build).
push-ds-fallback.debt: Needs a DS change: send localization keys the app bundle resolves (APNs title-loc-key/loc-key, an Android data-only fallback) or the device's language, backward-compatible with the oldest store build, which sends no language.

desktop-notifications.title: Desktop OS notifications
desktop-notifications.reason: Built in the renderer from chat:notify.* and friends.

desktop-tray.title: Desktop tray menu and tooltip
desktop-tray.reason: The shell draws the menu but the renderer owns the language: it sends common:tray.* through tray_set_labels / tray_set_unread on start and on every language switch. English until the renderer's first call.

core-errors.title: pollis-core error text shown verbatim
core-errors.reason: Screens show a failed command's message. The PIN and lock messages (wrong PIN with attempts left, locked out, no PIN, not signed in, unlock first) are mapped to errors:core.* at the bridge on both apps.
core-errors.debt: The rest of the core's messages reach the UI in English. They need stable error codes across the Tauri and uniffi boundaries (a pollis-core change, so a store build for mobile) and a key per code; map them incrementally, auth and security flows first.

ds-errors.title: Delivery Service error text passed through to the UI
ds-errors.reason: DS error bodies (an invalid code, a rate limit) are English strings the core forwards.
ds-errors.debt: Needs an error code in the DS's error body, which the client maps to a key; the client must keep showing the text for a DS that sends no code.

server-detail-strings.title: Server-written detail strings (build verification, account-key audit, voice errors)
server-detail-strings.reason: Human-readable `detail` text written by the server or the core and rendered verbatim.
server-detail-strings.debt: Needs a code instead of prose on the wire (or from the core), with the copy moved into the catalogues.

email-otp.title: Sign-in code email
email-otp.reason: Sent by the DS in English.
email-otp.debt: The user's language must reach the DS with the OTP request (a wire change). The oldest store build sends none, so the DS defaults to English for it.

email-change.title: Email-change verification emails
email-change.reason: Sent by the DS in English.
email-change.debt: Same as email-otp: the language must travel with the request, back-compatible with the oldest store build.

emoji-names.title: Emoji picker names and search keywords
emoji-names.reason: CLDR annotations per shipped locale, generated for both apps.

tui.title: Terminal client (pollis-tui)
tui.reason: A developer-facing terminal client with no localization layer; its help text is pinned by its own tests. Revisit if it becomes a supported end-user product.

pollis-verify.title: Verifier CLI (pollis-verify)
pollis-verify.reason: A developer tool whose commands and output are quoted verbatim in the English docs.

app-name.title: App name, window title, bundle display name
app-name.reason: Pollis is a brand name, the same in every language.

device-names.title: Default device names ("Pollis on macOS", "Pollis on iPhone")
device-names.reason: Stored once at enrolment and shown on every device of the account, which may each use a different language; it is a name, not UI copy.

release-notes.title: Release notes (desktop update screen, store "What's new")
release-notes.reason: Written per release in English (CHANGELOG.md, mobile/store/release-notes); translating them would need a reviewed translation per release.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics reports
diagnostics.reason: Developer-facing logs a user chooses to share with us; the controls around them are localized.

installers.title: Install scripts and desktop installers
installers.reason: Terminal install scripts and the platform installers' few lines; run once, before any language choice exists.

store-listing.title: App Store and Play listings
store-listing.reason: Maintained in docs/store-listing.md and entered in the store consoles by hand. Per-locale listings need reviewed marketing translations before they go public; revisit together with per-locale store screenshots (#1729).

website.title: Website (pollis.com)
website.reason: English only for now: public marketing, legal and policy pages need reviewed translations, and legal pages must stay authoritative in one language.

learn.title: /learn videos, captions and transcripts
learn.reason: English only for now: narrated videos whose scripts, captions and transcripts are kept in sync by check-learn-sync.mjs.

whitepaper.title: Security whitepaper
whitepaper.reason: English only for now: a technical document audited claim by claim (scripts/claims.json); a translation would need the same audit.

docs.title: Docs and READMEs
docs.reason: English only for now: developer and operator documentation.
